lead: A goal record's check can be filed in the crate whose *name* matches the subcommand, and the subcommand lives in `nvs-cli`.
body: `nvs serve` is a subcommand of the `nvs` binary (`crates/nvs-cli/src/serve.rs`); `nvs-server` is the accept-loop library it hands a bound socket to, resolves no configuration and boots nothing, and the manifest and `[lints]` triages both pass because `nvs-cli` depends on it. Triage a check naming a `nvs <verb>` behaviour by `grep -n 'Command::' crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs`, which lists every subcommand beside the module that answers it.
